relevant_data:
1 compartment: Biota (Biota, Aquatic)

23 biota samples. Species (2): Odobenus rosmarus rosmarus, Odobenus rosmarus divergens. Tissue types (6): Skin, Heart, Kidney, Liver, Lung, Muscle. Life stages (3): Adult, Embryo, Juvenile. Genders: Mixed

3 protocols:
Sampling Protocol - Biopsy: (Skin samples from O. r. rosmarus were collected using steel tips for arrows. Steel composition 12X18H10: 0.12% carbon (C), 18% chromium (Cr), 10% nickel (Ni), <0.8% titanium (Ti). Depth 1.5-2 cm, width 0.5 cm, weight about 5 g. Samples from O. r. divergens collected using medical scalpel. Skin samples about 2 cm depth and 2 cm width, weight about 15 g. Organ samples taken from any part, weight not less 15 g.)
Fractionation Protocol - Acid extractable: (Biomaterial samples were thawed at room temperature. Before analysis 1 to 5 g of sample was ashed in a muffle furnace at 450°C. The ash was dissolved in diluted nitric acid.)
Extraction Protocol - Acid digestion: (Biomaterial samples were thawed at room temperature. Before analysis 1 to 5 g of sample was ashed in a muffle furnace at 450°C. The ash was dissolved in diluted nitric acid.)
limitations: Species, tissue, age, gender well reported.
